system.notes:
THE BOOK: Chromebook 2 p.48, "Smoke/Tear Gas ... 3M/varies, 20eb - See CP rules for clouds; Tear Gas causes tearing & -2 REF, Smoke can't be seen thru." Chromebook 1 p.46: "Smoke or Tear Gas (5m diam., see Cyberpunk 2020 for effects.)" Home of the Brave p.86: "Chemical: This round carries smoke or gas and has a 5 meter radius", 30eb.

MODEL: carried as a Gas cloud region with no save penalty (stunSaveMod 0), so the cloud is on the map for its turns; smoke cannot be seen through - apply the sight block by hand.
system.source: Chromebook 2 p.48; Chromebook 1 p.46; Home of the Brave p.86
